title: Customers Delete Handler Permission Consistency

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.customers.delete permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing customer archive/restore authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing customer archive/restore auditing remains unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The customers route remains readable; only delete-class mutation handlers are hardened.

forms.reason: Archive and restore use confirmation actions rather than editable forms.

notes: CustomersPage already hid archive/restore entry points without fair_crm.customers.delete, but handleArchive and handleRestore lacked explicit fail-closed guards. Both handlers now return immediately when delete permission is absent.
